applePeer.kind: stock iPhone with AirDrop photo share sheet open
applePeer.identityBasis: the Mac awdl0 peer was independently identified as ea:33:2c:82:f5:7f; the target was a distinct ephemeral peer present during the user-controlled iPhone share-sheet session

advertisedChannelSequence.behavior: copied verbatim from the selected peer MIF into both the embedded synchronization sequence and standalone channel-sequence TLV

result.confirmed: Advertising the selected peer's observed channel sequence verbatim caused the stock iPhone to emit a Neighbor Advertisement and matching Echo Reply directly to the ESP32-S3. This proves bidirectional raw IPv6 over AWDL on the target hardware.
result.notConfirmed: The raw AWDL path is not yet attached to an ESP-IDF netif, mDNS has not passed bidirectionally, and sustained operation has not been measured.
result.nextFocus: Attach the proven frame path to an ESP-IDF netif and exchange AWDL mDNS on UDP port 5353.
